redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages or metadata used as validation receipts; access does not imply bulk redistribution or public-serving rights.
An exact official open resource whose licence, attribution, version, schema, coverage, CRS, and digest are pinned.
Permissioned, registered, paid, or otherwise controlled material retained and served only as permitted.
Unclear-rights, misprojected, personal, title/right, or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: Pinned public office page retaining page modification time, capture time, office name/address/CAP, interface URL, rights review, bytes and digest; office rows never become a complete assignment denominator or area.
Public operator statement that offices serve all Castelli; never interpreted as one office, one Castello, one CAP, or delivery-area equivalence.

sources.provider: Segreteria di Stato per gli Affari Interni
sources.production_scope: Nine Castelli names and governmental context only.

sources.provider: Repubblica di San Marino territorial map service
sources.production_scope: Administrative validation only unless exact resource rights and a correct CRS transformation are separately established. The inspected GeoJSON declares EPSG:4326 but lies at longitude 21.32-21.44 rather than San Marino, so it is fail-closed.

sources.provider: Ufficio Tecnico del Catasto e Cartografia
sources.production_scope: Mission and functions validate cartographic authority only; cadastral/building/right records and administrative GIS do not establish CAP membership.

artifact_partitions.rule: Poste San Marino assertions retain five-digit text, returned address/service context, capture time, version and digest; syntax and office occurrence never create a complete assignment.

Only a separately reviewed rights-cleared Polygon/MultiPolygon product with complete assignment/non-area reconciliation may be public output. Dogana/Serravalle membership and boundary must be source-defined.
Castelli and sobborghi remain administrative context and never create CAP membership.
Office location, opening and contact remain service context separate from assignment, area and deliverability.
Address, building, parcel, land-right and base-map assertions remain separate; protected fields never enter public artifacts.
Non-production fixture metadata only; never promotion evidence.
